description: This source file defines the DownloadController class and related data structures for managing download items, their states, and interactions with a database and download engine in a Flutter application.

classes.name: DownloadItem
classes.description: Represents an individual download item with properties like ID, content ID, title, status, progress, and timestamps.

classes.name: DownloadController
classes.description: Manages download items, handles their lifecycle, states, persistence, and interactions with the download engine and database.

methods.name: restoreFromDisk
methods.description: Restores the download items from the database and resumes download simulations for ongoing items if uploads are not paused.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new download item to the list and database, initiates download simulation if the queue is not paused.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a download item based on its content ID, cancels ongoing download, and updates storage.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the global download queue pause state and manages ongoing download activities accordingly.

methods.name: resumeItem
methods.description: Resumes a specific download item if the global queue is not paused.

methods.name: _setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and last updated timestamp of a download item in the database.

methods.name: _upsertProgress
methods.description: Updates the progress, status, and byte count of a download in the database.

methods.name: _startSimulation
methods.description: Starts a simulated download process for a given content ID, providing progress updates.
